For storage, capsules should be kept at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store them in the bathroom. The liquid form of this medication should be refrigerated and any unused liquid should be discarded after 72 hours. Do not freeze the liquid. When ready for use, the liquid form may be stored at room temperature for up to 3 hours. Medications should not be flushed down the toilet or poured into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly dispose of this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information was last updated in September 2024. It is important to note that this is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for you. Always seek advice from your healthcare professional for complete and personalized guidance regarding this product and your health needs.
